sources.finding: The surviving early-adopter guide describes choosing a project, creating an agent, prompting it like Claude Code, and receiving commits on the agent personal branch. It lists desktop distributions in an early-adopter Telegram group.

sources.title: Ariana historical authentication and VM execution
sources.finding: The historical guide describes using Claude subscription credentials on Ariana VMs. Windows reads the Claude credentials file; macOS requires manual token copying and repeat setup after expiry. GitHub OAuth grants repository access. These are historical instructions, not a fresh verification of current provider authorization or service availability.
